decision_connection.kindHint: Answers with probabilities; reviews requests, runs no agent
decision_connection.localRequests: On this computer; requests stay here
decision_connection.remoteRequests: Off this computer, under the server provider’s terms
decision_connection.reviewerMissing: This model is no longer listed. Every request comes to you until a listed model is chosen.
decision_connection.name: Name
decision_connection.editLead: A model that answers a question with a probability instead of writing text. It reviews requests; agents never run on it.
decision_connection.editKeyHint: A project secret holds it; only the reviewer’s request carries it
decision_connection.editKeyInfo: Choose a project secret or create one here. Its value goes only to the secret store and the server request, never into the connection or automation’s view.
decision_connection.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL without credentials, query or fragment.
decision_connection.modelsHint: What the server lists; the reviewer picks one
decision_connection.completeFields: Enter a valid name and base URL, and complete or choose the key secret.
decision_connection.personOnly: A reviewer on a server off this computer is a person’s change: only you can save it.
decision_connection.secretPersonOnly: Creating a key secret needs a person, or permission for automation to change agent permissions.
decision_connection.editLocal: Requests go to the server on this computer. Nothing is sent off it. Start the server yourself; Orchester does not install or start it. Secret values are never sent as project content.
decision_connection.editHosted: Each request the reviewer judges is sent to {{host}} with this key: the command or tool call, its working folder, the agent’s note and last messages, and the task’s title, brief and criteria, redacted as the approval card shows them. Secret values never are. The server provider’s terms and data policy apply.
decision_connection.deleteUsed: Choose another reviewer before deleting this connection.
decision_connection.deleteBody: The server connection and its recorded checks will be removed. Its project secret stays.
decision_connection.keyNote: Requests come to you until the key works. The key itself is never shown.
decision_connection.localNote: Start the server, then Check again. Orchester does not start or install it.
decision_connection.remoteNote: Check that the server is running and its address is reachable, then Check again.
decision_connection.apiNote: Only a server of the System One API can review. Its base URL ends before /systemone.
decision_connection.modelNote: Every request comes to you until a listed model is chosen in Runs › Approvals.
